rationale_one_line: A bold manifesto for a counterintuitive tool: a coding agent that edits video without ever watching a frame, carried by real mechanism beats, in browser-use's own blue-on-near-black.
writing_tone_notes: Build-in-public peer voice matching Magnus and Gregor: declarative, specific, admiring without hype. The mechanism is the awe, not adjectives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Board the product beats first (terminal typing the real prompt, the loop diagram), place the one growth beat late
Spend the contrast budget on the money shot: the inverted 'never watches' reveal
Keep the brand blue as a graphic accent; hero text stays near-white ink
Close rhymes with the open wordmark so the autoloop replays clean
dont_rules: No SCHEMATIC (caveman used it this morning, back-to-back blocked)
No aurora background (caveman used it); grid reads like an editing timeline
No second engagement metric beyond the star count; everything else is a capability fact
No invented terminal lines; every typed line traces to repo-study with a source URL
